question: In which kinds of patients did SGLT2 inhibitors show robust clinical evidence of reducing death from any cause and from cardiovascular disease? Name one.
answers: Patients with type 2 diabetes (and those without it)

receipt.quote: SGLT2i demonstrated the most robust clinical evidence for reduction of death from any cause and CVD, in patients with or without T2D, heart failure, and chronic kidney disease (CKD) (Cavender et al., 2018; Heerspink et al., 2020; Neal et al., 2017; Packer et al., 2020; Perkovic et al., 2019).

question: In a 2022 review scoring drugs that could be repurposed against ageing, why did SGLT2 inhibitors get the top score?
answers: Robust effects on rodent healthspan and lifespan, plus strong evidence of longer healthspan and lower mortality in humans

receipt.quote: SGLT2 inhibitors (SGLT2i), a relatively new drug class, was the only one to receive the maximum score, owing to not only its robust effects on improving rodent healthspan and lifespan (including ITP) but also strong evidence for the extension of healthspan and reduction of mortality in humans.
